text.arabic_uthmani: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction of continuation, joining the new divine-action clause to the prior subjection sequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the ayah begin as continuation, not as an isolated assertion. It carries the prior sea-subjection scene of 45:12 into a widened cosmic claim, so the reader hears one accumulating proof sequence. Its light opening also lets the connector run straight into the heavier action that follows.

topics.headline: coordinated continuation from 45:12
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this ayah as an added member of the 45:12 subjection sequence, not as an isolated doctrine.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction is locally attached to the new divine-action clause and the CRITICAL boundary rows specify continuation from 45:12.

topics.headline: connector fused into action sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the small connector run into the heavier following action.
topics.reason: The sound row adds audible texture to the locally established continuation.

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect divine act of subjecting or harnessing, binding beneficiary and both cosmic object-domains in one completed predicate
words.root_gloss_range: subjection, harnessing, assigned service, and a lowering-into-use field; locally Form II selects divine ordering into service, not mockery
words.prose: {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}) fixes the whole survey under one completed divine act before the beneficiaries and domains are named. The Form II and service field make usefulness feel like imposed, governed assignment, while the local frame selects serviceable ordering rather than mockery. Its recurrence from 45:12 and its cosmic pairings such as 13:2 and 14:32-33 make the move from sea to total cosmos a governed expansion. The geminated center gives that constraining action audible weight.

topics.headline: single completed verb governs the survey
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees beneficiary and both cosmic domains held inside one completed divine predicate.
topics.reason: Local grammar makes the Form II perfect verb transitive over the beneficiary and two coordinated object domains.

topics.headline: service field without mockery sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels usefulness as assigned service while keeping mockery outside the local sense.
topics.reason: The root-family pressure of lowering into service survives, but the local divine-action frame selects governed service rather than ridicule.

topics.headline: Form II imposed serviceability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that usefulness is made and governed, not simply found in nature.
topics.reason: The aligned form is Form II perfect, and the CRITICAL rows connect the doubled form with intensified causative ordering.

topics.headline: sea subjection expanded to cosmic taskhir (45:12; 14:32-33)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same subjecting act from the sea in 45:12 to the full cosmic inventory, with 13:2 and 14:32-33 as broader taskhir parallels.
topics.reason: The source rows name recurrence from 45:12 and parallels such as 14:32-33, while local syntax expands the object field to both domains.

topics.headline: geminated center as constraining pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears constraining pressure concentrated in the verb sound.
topics.reason: The sound row adds audible texture that matches the retained service-ordering payoff.

words.gloss_range: benefactive prepositional phrase with second-person plural suffix, marking the addressed group as recipients rather than agents or owners
words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) places the addressed group between divine action and the vast object, so benefit appears early without making humans the agents. The lām relation is allocation and benefit, not ownership, especially once the later source phrase traces the whole totality back to Him. The suffix continues the audience from 45:12 before the close shifts to a reflective third-person people.

topics.headline: addressed beneficiaries, not agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressees placed inside the benefit relation while agency stays with the divine verb.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the phrase a benefactive complement of the subjecting verb.

topics.headline: benefit does not become ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps benefit distinct from possession or authorship.
topics.reason: The later source phrase supports the CRITICAL limit that the benefactive relation does not make humans owners or agents.

topics.headline: same addressed audience from 45:12
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the second-person audience from 45:12 into the expanded cosmic argument before the close shifts to a reflective people.
topics.reason: The suffix maintains the addressee chain described in the boundary rows from 45:12.

words.gloss_range: first relative object-domain, open-ended over whatever is in the heavens rather than a named inventory
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the first object as an unitemized relative field. The heavenly contents remain broader than a catalogue of named objects, and the stable particle form avoids number, gender, and definiteness limits. By delaying the domain noun, the word lets breadth arrive before location, and it prepares the matching second relative frame.

topics.headline: first open relative object-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the heavenly object field as wider than any named inventory.
topics.reason: Local syntax identifies this as the first relative object-domain of the subjecting verb.

topics.headline: first relative opening prepares the second
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first open object setting up an equal second object frame.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL echo row is supported by the coordinated second relative domain.

words.gloss_range: locative/domain preposition completing the first relative phrase and making the heavens a containing field
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) completes the first relative clause by turning the open object into a located domain. The preposition makes the heavens a containing field of realities, not merely a place name. As the first of the repeated locative frames, it starts the balanced architecture that will later be echoed and transformed in the sign clause. Its short high vowel helps bind the relative phrase tightly.

topics.headline: first locative relative completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the open object being converted into a containing heavenly domain.
topics.reason: The preposition supplies the relative complement and governs the upper-domain noun.

topics.headline: first frame of the repeated locative architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees vertical totality being built syntactically before it is named.
topics.reason: The row family points to the repeated locative frame that is locally present at both domain phrases.

topics.headline: light vowel binds the phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the relative phrase held together by a light prepositional sound.
topics.reason: The sound row adds texture to the locally licensed prepositional frame.

words.gloss_range: definite plural upper cosmic domain, genitive after the first locative frame and paired with the earth as one pole of totality
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, and upperness; locally the identifiable plural upper cosmic domain under serviceable order
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:s-samāwāt}}) supplies the identifiable plural upper pole of the object field. Its elevation-root pressure makes the unreachable height itself feel brought under serviceable order, while the local noun remains the heavens rather than a free root abstraction. The plural upper pole stands across from the singular earth, and comparisons such as 2:29 and same-surah sign units at 45:3 and 45:5 show this pair being recast here as serviceable evidence. The long vowel span widens the upper pole before the lower pole closes it.

topics.headline: definite plural upper domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the upper pole as identifiable, plural, and grammatically contained by the locative frame.
topics.reason: The aligned noun is a definite plural governed by the first locative preposition.

topics.headline: elevation pressure under serviceable order
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels unreachable height being included in the subjected order, while the local noun remains the heavens.
topics.reason: The elevation pressure is coherent for this root and noun, but the local surface selects the upper cosmic pole rather than an abstract root meaning.

topics.headline: heavens-earth evidence field (2:29; 45:3; 45:5)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the upper pole as half of a familiar heavens-earth totality, recast here as serviceable evidence after sign units such as 45:3 and 45:5.
topics.reason: The source rows give the heavens-earth pairing, 2:29 as a comparison, and same-surah recurrence at 45:3 and 45:5.

topics.headline: long-vowel upper span
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the upper pole stretched before the lower pole closes the pair.
topics.reason: The sound row adds an audible contrast between the upper and lower poles.

words.gloss_range: medial conjunction coordinating the second relative domain under the same governing verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second relative domain under the same governing act. It adds the earth side without creating a second agency or making the lower domain a supplement. The repeated connector turns the ayah’s opening continuation into internal coordination, and the sound of the phrase restarts the same light relative frame.

topics.headline: second domain coordinated under one verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees earth added without a second agency or a subordinate status.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the second relative object-domain with the first under the same verb.

topics.headline: opening continuation becomes internal coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah’s connective opening repeated inside the object list.
topics.reason: The echo rows preserve a real internal coordination payoff without changing the local parse.

topics.headline: restarted light relative cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second domain enter with a matching light syllable frame.
topics.reason: The sound row supports the audible parallelism of the repeated relative frame.

words.gloss_range: second relative object-domain, giving the earth field the same open-ended scope as the heavenly field
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) gives the earthly side its own open relative entry. The second domain is grammatically included under the same subjecting verb, not merely inferred from the heavens-earth pair. Repetition makes the lower field structurally equal to the upper field before the later totalizer gathers both.

topics.headline: second coordinated open object-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees terrestrial realities included by grammar and kept open-ended.
topics.reason: Local syntax makes this the second relative object-domain coordinated with the first.

topics.headline: matching relative frames before totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both domains receive equal open scope before the totalizer gathers them.
topics.reason: The repeated relative frame is locally present and prepares the later totalizing word.

words.gloss_range: second locative/domain preposition, mirroring the first and making the earth a containing field
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) mirrors the earlier locative frame and turns the earth into a containing domain. The syntax therefore subjects what is within the lower field, not only a flat place-name. This repeated preposition builds vertical symmetry before the totalizer names it, while the shorter closing phrase gives the lower pole a denser sound.

topics.headline: second locative relative completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earth side being made a containing domain rather than a flat object.
topics.reason: The preposition supplies the relative complement and governs the earth noun.

topics.headline: balanced locative parallelism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the heavens-earth totality enacted by repeated prepositional syntax.
topics.reason: The second preposition mirrors the first and creates the balanced frame named by the totalizer.

topics.headline: shorter lower-pole closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the lower pole close more compactly after the repeated opening.
topics.reason: The sound row adds an audible distinction between the two poles.

words.gloss_range: definite singular lower cosmic realm, genitive after the second locative frame and closing the merism before the totalizer
words.root_gloss_range: ground, land, earth, and the lower material realm; locally the definite singular terrestrial pole of the merism
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾarḍ}}) closes the merism as the definite singular lower realm. The root pressure of ground, land, and world is gathered into one terrestrial pole, while the singular form resists a reading of scattered territories. Placed immediately before the totalizer, it lets the totalizing word sweep back over a completed heavens-earth pair, with comparisons such as 2:29 recast from creation-order into serviceable evidence for reflection; the earth pole also anticipates the closing reflection verb. Its dense onset and final emphatic closure fit the grounded pole.

topics.headline: definite singular lower realm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earth gathered as one lower pole, not as scattered territories.
topics.reason: The noun is definite singular and governed by the second locative preposition.

topics.headline: grounded material pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the descent from elevated realities to the grounded material realm.
topics.reason: The root field of ground and land fits the local noun while the heavens-earth pair stretches it to the whole lower realm.

topics.headline: earth closes the merism before totalization (2:29)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the totalizer sweep back over a completed two-pole structure, with 2:29 as a creation-order comparison.
topics.reason: The source rows identify earth as the lower pole paired with heavens and compare the pair with 2:29.

topics.headline: dense grounded closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the lower pole close with a denser sound shape than the upper pole.
topics.reason: The sound row adds audible texture to the grounded-pole payoff.

words.gloss_range: accusative circumstantial totalizer, gathering the two cosmic domains into one all-together subjected field
words.root_gloss_range: gathering, assembling, total collection, and collective wholeness; locally an accusative totalizer over both domains
words.prose: {{ar:جَمِيعًۭا}} ({{tr:jamīʿan}}) turns the two domains into one all-together circumstance of subjection. The gathering root excludes a selective reading: the claim is not a few useful benefits but a collected cosmic field. Its nominal accusative form adds totality without introducing a competing action, and its position pivots from scope to provenance before the source phrase. Related rows such as 45:26 and 6:38 show the same gathering field moving from cosmic serviceability to gathered humans and creatures gathered to their Lord.

topics.headline: accusative totality as circumstance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees totality as the condition of the subjected domains, not a second event.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence supports the accusative circumstantial totalizer over both object domains.

topics.headline: gathered whole without remainder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the claim exclude leftover domains or merely selective benefit.
topics.reason: The gathering root and local totalizer position make the two domains one collected field.

topics.headline: totality pivots to source (45:26; 6:38)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the totalizer sealing the merism before provenance, with 45:26 and 6:38 showing related gathering pressure.
topics.reason: The source rows name 45:26 and 6:38, while local syntax places the totalizer between the merism and the source phrase.

topics.headline: tanwin cadence links totality to reception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a light indefinite cadence that later reappears with signs and people.
topics.reason: The sound row supplies a local acoustic link without changing the parse.

words.gloss_range: source phrase after the totalizer, tracing the entire gathered subjection back to Him, with variant pressure toward explicit favor
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}) attaches provenance to the whole gathered totality, not to one nearby benefit. The suffix sends source back to the divine actor without repeating the name, so utility is read through origin before the sign claim begins. The variant pressure toward favor narrows the same slot from source-language into explicit benefaction: one reading lets favor stand resumptively after the totality, another makes it an accusative favor, while neither changes the cosmic scope; 16:53 gives the source logic a concrete parallel. Its sound cluster keeps source-reference and favor-pressure close together.

topics.headline: source attached to the totalized whole (16:53)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader traces the whole useful cosmos back to Him, with 16:53 as a concrete every-blessing source parallel.
topics.reason: The phrase follows the totalizer, the suffix resumes the divine subject, and the source rows cite 16:53.

topics.headline: variant pressure from source to favor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same post-totalizer slot press toward explicit favor without losing the source reading or the total scope.
topics.reason: The canonical local surface marks provenance, while accepted variant rows make favor-language a controlled contrast rather than a replacement.

words.gloss_range: confirming particle that pivots from sourced benefit to an emphatic nominal sign-claim
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the confirmed inference after the source phrase. The particle pivots from benefited creation to an asserted sign statement: the totality from Him is not spiritually neutral. It also prepares the later emphatic segment on the sign noun, so confirmation surrounds the claim. The nasal hinge from the source phrase into this particle makes the inferential turn audible.

topics.headline: confirmed inference after source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah turn from sourced benefit to asserted evidence.
topics.reason: The particle opens the nominal evidentiary clause after the source phrase.

topics.headline: prepares the later inna-la emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that signhood is explicitly confirmed rather than left as a neutral observation.
topics.reason: The later emphatic segment on the sign noun completes the emphasis frame begun here.

topics.headline: nasal hinge into assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the source phrase and confirmed assertion joined by sound.
topics.reason: The sound row adds audible transition to the established discourse pivot.

words.gloss_range: fronted predicate preposition, relocating signhood inside the prior arrangement rather than merely inside physical space
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) fronts the place where signs are found before the signs are named. Here containment shifts from physical domain to evidence-domain: the signs are in that whole arrangement. By reprising the earlier two locative frames, this third use transforms location into interpretation. The repeated prepositional sound carries the ayah from in the upper domain, to in the lower domain, to in that totality.

topics.headline: fronted location of signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader re-enters the prior totality before the sign noun is named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes this prepositional phrase the fronted predicate frame for the sign noun.

topics.headline: from physical location to evidence-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same locative word reused to shift from where things are to where signs are found.
topics.reason: The third preposition echoes the earlier two domain prepositions and changes their function in the sign clause.

topics.headline: threefold prepositional thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a repeated sound thread from the two domains to the final evidence-field.
topics.reason: The sound row tracks the repeated prepositional surface across the ayah.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative compressing the preceding subjection complex into one inspectable evidence-field
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) compresses the entire preceding subjection complex into one pointer. The distal form creates contemplative distance, making the benefited world something to inspect rather than merely consume. The same compressed referent is where signs are located and what the closing reflection turns over. Near the end, it returns the reader to the act opened by the subjecting verb.

topics.headline: whole subjection complex compressed into one pointer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior verb, beneficiary, domains, totality, and source gathered into one inspectable referent.
topics.reason: The demonstrative reference is locally licensed as resuming the preceding cosmic subjection complex.

topics.headline: distal pointer creates reflective distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the benefited world set at a distance for inspection rather than immediate consumption.
topics.reason: The distal demonstrative form supports the CRITICAL payoff of contemplative distance.

words.gloss_range: emphatic segment attached to the sign noun, reinforcing signhood rather than benefit or ownership
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) lands its emphasis on the sign noun. It is not the benefactive particle of the earlier beneficiary phrase or the later recipient phrase; it asserts signhood itself. Together with the confirming particle, it forms stacked emphasis so the useful cosmos is not left as neutral utility. Its meeting with the following hamzated noun sharpens the assertion point.

topics.headline: emphasis lands on the sign noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees assertion fall on signhood itself, not on possession, utility, or the recipient group.
topics.reason: The segment attaches directly to the delayed sign noun in the evidentiary clause.

topics.headline: inna-la frame resists neutral utility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the claim that the useful totality contains signs is rhetorically reinforced.
topics.reason: The particle works with the earlier confirming particle to form stacked emphasis.

topics.headline: sharp onset at assertion point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the assertion sharpen as emphasis meets the following hamzated noun.
topics.reason: The sound row adds local acoustic payoff at the emphatic landing point.

words.gloss_range: delayed indefinite plural sign noun, recoding the useful totality as multiple readable indicators for reflection
words.root_gloss_range: sign, mark, proof, and readable indicator, with a contested return/refuge pressure kept secondary; locally plural signhood is primary
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتٍ}} ({{tr:ʾāyātin}}) arrives late and names the category the prior totality has been waiting for. The indefinite plural leaves the signs multiple and open-ended, and the sign sense recodes resources as readable indicators. The root-dispute pressure toward return remains secondary: signhood is primary here, while the alternate image supports being sent back to the evidence. Formula rows such as 30:21 and same-surah sign units at 45:3-5 show this sign language being specialized here for sustained reflection.

topics.headline: delayed indefinite plural signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits for the category that explains the totality, then receives it as many open-ended signs.
topics.reason: The sign noun is delayed after the fronted predicate, indefinite, and plural.

topics.headline: resources recoded as signs with secondary return pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees useful phenomena become readable indicators, while the alternate root image only reinforces return to evidence.
topics.reason: The local noun selects signhood; the contested root pressure survives only as secondary image-pressure.

topics.headline: signs for reflective people (30:21; 45:3-5)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places this sign noun inside a reception formula specialized by reflection, with 30:21 and 45:3-5 as concrete reference points.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cite 30:21 and 45:3-5 and connect the noun with people and reflection.

topics.headline: tanwin link to receiving people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the sign noun acoustically linked to the group that can receive it.
topics.reason: The sound row adds a small local acoustic link between signs and people.

words.gloss_range: recipient/specification preposition, directing the signs to the people who can effectively receive them
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) turns from asserted signs to their effective audience. It does not make the signs physically exclusive; it marks the group for whom they become beneficially readable. The particle therefore narrows uptake after broad signhood, setting up the people defined by reflection. Its light bridge also binds the sign noun to the receptive group.

topics.headline: recipient li narrows uptake, not existence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees broad signs become effectively beneficial for a reflective people without denying their wider presence.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the people as the audience or recipient for the signs.

topics.headline: light bridge from signs to people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a narrow bridge joining signhood to its receptive group.
topics.reason: The sound row adds acoustic texture to the recipient relation.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular collective people, qualitative rather than ethnic, completed by the following reflection verb
words.root_gloss_range: standing, establishment, uprightness, communal grouping, and maintained posture; locally a qualitative collective people
words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمٍ}} ({{tr:qawmin}}) names a qualitative collective, not an ethnic label. Its singular collective form and plural verbal agreement make reflection a shared communal posture, while the following verb supplies the defining quality. The standing-root pressure frames that people as a body oriented toward the signs. Formula rows such as 2:164 and the boundary from gratitude in 45:12 show the recipient class becoming a reflective community.

topics.headline: qualitative collective defined by reflection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the recipient group as any community characterized by ongoing reflection, not a named ethnicity.
topics.reason: The indefinite singular collective is qualified by the following plural imperfect verb.

topics.headline: standing-root communal posture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels reflection as a shared orientation or posture, while local grammar keeps the sense as a people.
topics.reason: The root pressure of standing and establishment survives as image-pressure, not as a replacement for the collective noun.

topics.headline: signs for a people formula (2:164; 45:12)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this people-noun to sign-reception formulas such as 2:164, while the boundary from 45:12 turns gratitude into reflective community.
topics.reason: The source rows cite 2:164 and 45:12 and identify the sign-people-reflection field.

words.gloss_range: Form V imperfect plural reflection verb, closing the ayah on ongoing deliberate thought over the prior totality
words.root_gloss_range: pondering, turning something over mentally, and deliberate reflection; locally ongoing Form V reflective processing
words.prose: {{ar:يَتَفَكَّرُونَ}} ({{tr:yatafakkarūn}}) closes the ayah on ongoing plural reflection. The Form V makes the act deliberate and self-involving, and the understood object sends thought back to the whole demonstrative totality rather than leaving it objectless. Creation-reflection parallels such as 3:191 and 30:21 are specialized here around subjected creation, so full reception requires cognition, not exposure alone. The doubled consonant gives the final act the audible pressure of sustained thinking.

topics.headline: Form V imperfect plural reflection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees reflection as repeated, deliberate, and shared, not a completed flash of recognition.
topics.reason: The aligned form is Form V imperfect 3MP and locally qualifies the people.

topics.headline: reflection turns the totality over in the mind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees cognition as the channel through which signs complete their function.
topics.reason: The root field of pondering and the local adjectival clause make the prior totality an object of sustained mental processing.

topics.headline: creation reflection specialized by taskhir (3:191; 30:21; 45:12)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the closing verb to creation-reflection passages such as 3:191 and 30:21, while 45:12 supplies the adjacent gratitude response.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cite 3:191, 30:21, and the boundary with 45:12 as concrete parallels or contrasts.

topics.headline: doubled consonant weights deliberation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final cognition verb carry internal pressure suited to sustained thought.
topics.reason: The sound row adds audible support for the deliberative payoff.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative verb at word 1 governs the complete contents of the upper and lower domains for the addressees, while the unrooted phrase at words 10-11 marks their source in Him.
baseline_models.mechanism: Directed subjection joins height, ground, and exhaustive totality into one usable order. The beneficiary relation concerns access and tractability; the source phrase keeps that access from becoming a transfer of title.

activation_trace.role: Supplies being made tractable and driven toward a purpose, the governing action of the model.
Supplies the encompassing upper domain as one pole of the ordered field.
Supplies the lower counterpart, completing the vertical span under the governing action.
Makes the scope whole and without remainder rather than a selection of convenient objects.

changed_reading.before: The ayah says that God made many cosmic things useful to humans.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents the complete high-to-low order as purposefully tractable for human use while remaining sourced in, and therefore not owned apart from, Him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The upper domain at word 5 is followed by the lower domain, exhaustive totality, visible signs, and iterative reflection.
baseline_models.mechanism: A non-dominant mapped branch lets the upper domain activate visible marking. Joined to explicit signs and the heart's repeated movement, the total cosmos becomes a legible field whose details disclose condition and source.

activation_trace.role: Contributes a visible trace from which a condition is discerned, turning the upper domain into sign-bearing surface.
Collects dispersed details into one readable configuration.
Identifies the readable details as outwardly available indicators.
Supplies recurrent inward movement that connects separate indicators into a reading.

changed_reading.before: Signs are objects located somewhere inside the heavens and earth.
changed_reading.after: The gathered upper-lower whole is itself a marked and legible configuration, and reflection is the repeated traversal by which its traces become signs.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final construction assigns the signs to a qawm characterized by the reflexive-imperfect act of thinking.
baseline_models.mechanism: The audience noun carries both collectivity and latent rising into an undertaking. Reflection is therefore a shared posture of repeatedly taking up and caring for what the signs disclose, not a label for an already intellectual class.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the social body in which the reading occurs.
Adds resolve and rising into an undertaking, making the audience designation active.
Adds sustained care, so recognition can issue in custodial attention.
Keeps the collective posture iterative and inwardly revisable rather than instantaneous.

changed_reading.before: A pre-existing group called thinkers notices the signs.
changed_reading.after: A people becomes the relevant qawm by repeatedly taking up, revisiting, and caring for the implications of the sign-bearing order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier descent-revival-wind sequence and the immediately preceding sea example unpack subjection as coordinated motion: provision is delivered, dead ground is revived, air is turned, a vessel runs under command, and humans still must seek and answer with gratitude. Cosmic service is an affordance structure, not inert inventory.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the contextual motions in the focus verb's directed tractability.
Contributes delivery from above as the first transfer in the enabling chain.
Contributes the land's revival through rain and growth as an effect of that transfer.
Contributes controlled turning from state to state, making variability part of the service.
Supplies moving air as the material carried through the controlled turning.
Contributes actual running and flow, converting tractability into transport.
Places the vessel's motion under directive constraint rather than autonomous drift.
Requires the beneficiary to seek within the enabled field, preserving human agency.
Makes recognition of the giver the fitting return from successful use.

structural_cues: 45:5 orders descent, provision, revival after death, and wind-turning as a causal sequence.
45:12 repeats the focus construction, then coordinates vessel motion, human seeking, and hoped-for gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered transfers, directed motion, seeking, and gratitude; I infer that these exemplify how subjection works as enabling conditions plus responsive agency. A live alternative is that the ayat merely lists separate benefits without defining a common mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Subjection means that finished cosmic objects have been placed at human disposal.
changed_reading.after: Subjection is a maintained network of flows and constraints that enables human action, still requiring search, correct use, and gratitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first names the preceding phenomena as divine signs being recited in truth, then calls the revelatory presentation inward sights, guidance, and mercy. Natural configuration and verbal presentation become two modes in one sign process that forms perception rather than merely supplying data.

activation_trace.role: Anchors both contextual modes in the focus ayah's outwardly available indicators.
Provides the recurrent cognitive motion through which world and recitation are integrated.
Contributes ordered following, letting verbal recitation continue the sequence of cosmic signs.
Grounds that continuation in correspondence with reality rather than free association.
Turns signs from external evidence into cultivated inward sight.
Gives the perceptual formation a gentle direction toward a path and truth.

structural_cues: 45:6 points back to the preceding cosmic sequences with a plural demonstrative and then describes their recitation.
45:20 predicates plural perceptual faculties, guidance, and mercy of the present discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one sign vocabulary across phenomena and recitation plus an inward-sight predicate; I infer a continuous world-text pedagogy. The alternative is a looser analogy between two independent classes of evidence.

changed_reading.before: Reflection inspects natural signs, while revelation is a separate source of instruction.
changed_reading.after: The world and its truthful recitation cooperate in one sign process: external marks are followed until they become inward sight and directed understanding.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing can occur without understanding or compliance, self-magnification can preserve refusal, and desire can organize perception until hearing and heart are sealed and sight covered. The focus audience is therefore defined by a resistible discipline of reflection, not by unavoidable inference from an available cosmos.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the repeated inward movement the focus ayah calls for.
Distinguishes acoustic reception from the understanding and compliance that can be refused.
Supplies self-exalting magnitude as the posture that blocks receptive change.
Makes inward inclination a rival organizer of what the subject will perceive.
Contributes secured closure, the limiting endpoint of sustained refusal.
Locates the closure in the same inward organ whose motion supports reflection.
Adds an overlying cover, showing that exposed signs need not become effective sight.

structural_cues: 45:8 explicitly sequences hearing, persistence, arrogance, and acting as though no hearing occurred.
45:23 coordinates enthroned desire with closures on hearing, heart, and sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed hearing and a desire-seal-cover cluster; I infer a process in which posture can disable reflection despite available signs. A live alternative is that the closures describe judgment after refusal rather than a cognitive process generated by it.

changed_reading.before: A fully available sign-filled cosmos naturally produces reflection in anyone who encounters it.
changed_reading.after: Availability creates the occasion for reflection but does not determine it; reflection is a moral-cognitive discipline that arrogance and desire can actively resist.

context_deltas.mechanism: The beneficiary grammar of the focus is answered by the later for-self and against-self grammar: intended acts accrue to the acting self, return follows, and every self receives the counterpart of what it acquired without deprivation. Tractable creation is thus an accountable arena, not a grant of consequence-free consumption.

activation_trace.role: Anchors accountability in the directed availability asserted by the focus verb.
Extends that accountable arena across the whole field rather than a protected sacred subset.
Contributes intentional action as what the beneficiary does within the enabled field.
Fixes benefit and harm on the actor's own self rather than on an abstract collective.
Adds return, preventing present access from being the terminal horizon.
Supplies an answering counterpart to action, making use consequential.
Frames deeds as acquisitions whose yield adheres to the acquiring self.
Contributes withholding from a due right, which the negative construction excludes from recompense.

structural_cues: 45:15 mirrors benefit-for-self with harm-upon-self before return to the Lord.
45:22 places creation of the same upper and lower domains beside recompense for every self's acquisition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored beneficiary language, return, creation, acquisition, and recompense; I infer that cosmic availability is the arena in which accountable use occurs. The alternative is that ethical recompense is adjacent to, but not interpretively limiting, the focus grant.

changed_reading.before: For you describes a one-way cosmic benefit whose meaning ends in present usefulness.
changed_reading.after: For you grants a field of action whose uses accrue back to each self and are answered at return, so availability and accountability are inseparable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claim that extended time alone destroys is marked as unsupported supposition, while dominion over the same upper and lower domains is assigned to God. This sharpens the focus phrase from Him into a denial that a coherent, regular cosmos is therefore self-grounding.

activation_trace.role: Anchors regular cosmic tractability as an ordered relation rather than an ultimate agent.
Contributes extended time as the proposed closed explanation that the context contests.
Classifies that closure as uncertain imagining rather than established knowledge.
Reassigns sovereignty over the focus domains to God and blocks autonomous ownership.

structural_cues: 45:24 gives an exclusive time-based account of life and death, then denies it knowledge status.
45:27 repeats the heavens-earth pair inside an explicit divine dominion construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rejected exclusive appeal to time and a later dominion claim; I infer that the focus source phrase guards against mistaking regular mediation for ultimate source. The alternative is that 45:24 contests resurrection denial only, without commenting on how 45:13's cosmic order is understood.

changed_reading.before: From Him simply identifies the donor of an otherwise self-running natural system.
changed_reading.after: From Him is an anti-closure claim: regular cosmic processes remain mediated signs and possessions of their source, not a self-sufficient causal ultimate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus totalizer acquires a temporal counterpart when persons are gathered to a day, every community kneels and is called to its book, and the copied record becomes articulate evidence. The whole subjected field is not only a present resource system; it anticipates an assembly in which communal and individual uses become legible testimony.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the changed model in the focus ayah's complete, remainderless totality.
Transfers collection from present things to persons summoned toward an appointed day.
Supplies accountable communities as the social units within the later totalization.
Gives the assembly a bodily posture of kneeling rather than mastery.
Contributes the summons that draws each community toward its record.
Turns the record into evidence that signifies as though speaking.
Supplies faithful transfer into a written copy, preserving acts for the assembly.

structural_cues: 45:26 explicitly gathers the addressees toward the day of rising.
45:28 repeats every community and every community, then calls each to its book.
45:29 presents the book as speaking truth because deeds were being copied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated gathering root, universal communities, bodily assembly, summons, and copied testimony; I infer that the focus totality foreshadows this evidentiary totalization. The live alternative is simple root recurrence with distinct present-cosmic and future-human referents.

changed_reading.before: All together only measures the present extent of what has been made available.
changed_reading.after: All together also opens a temporal arc: the complete field of present affordances tends toward a complete assembly where its human uses are gathered and made to speak.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus root's coerced, unwaged labor branch inside a verse conventionally heard as benefaction. It remains anchored in the causative verb and the exhaustive beneficiary construction, while 45:12's seeking and gratitude keep the ethical pressure live. Render it as a critique of beneficiary entitlement, not as a claim that the morphology literally calls the cosmos an exploited employee.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb at word 1, the beneficiary pronoun, and exhaustive word 9 place an entire working order in relation to human advantage.

activation_trace.role: Introduces compelled work without wage as an ethical shadow of cosmic service.
Extends the uncomfortable labor image across the whole beneficiary field.
Shows beneficiaries seeking within the service rather than owning its source.
Places acknowledgment of the giver against appropriation by the beneficiary.

changed_reading.before: The cosmos is a costless stock of gifts belonging to its human beneficiary.
changed_reading.after: The unwaged-labor shadow exposes the moral danger in treating total cosmic service as entitlement; receiving use should produce accountable gratitude, not a claim of ownership.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it combines two non-dominant mapped inventories attached to the focus upper-domain root. It remains valid as a packet-supplied material analogy, especially beside descent and moving air. Downstream prose should call the cosmos as marked apertures an exploratory model of routed passage, never substitute it for the ordinary lexical reading of heavens.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The upper domain at word 5 participates in split mapped branches for visible marking and narrow passage, while word 14 explicitly names signs.

activation_trace.role: Contributes readable traces by which passage or condition becomes perceptible.
Contributes a narrow port through which something enters, materializing mediated transfer.
Lets the traces of routed transfer function as visible indicators.
Supplies downward delivery as one packet-grounded instance of passage.
Supplies moving air as another material passing through the cosmic circuit.

changed_reading.before: The upper realm is a container that happens to hold signs.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the upper-lower whole resembles a marked and ported circuit: provision and air pass through it, and their visible traces make mediation readable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form denotes causative subjection, whereas ridicule normally requires a different construction. It remains anchored through the focus inventory's live ridicule branch and the context's repeated treatment of signs as mockery followed by surrounding consequence. Render it only as a rhetorical reversal of imagined mastery, not as a replacement translation of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 1 carries a latent ridicule branch inside a statement of human-facing subjection.

activation_trace.role: Activates ridicule as the reversible shadow of the beneficiary's apparent mastery.
Shows the first conversion of known signs into an object of ridicule.
Supplies the reversal in which the mocked consequence descends and encloses the mocker.
Repeats ridicule of the signs as the reason the reversal is no accidental wordplay.

changed_reading.before: Human beings stand securely above a cosmos subjected for them.
changed_reading.after: As a contained rhetorical reversal, treating the subjected sign-world as an entitlement to mock can expose the would-be master as the one enclosed by what was mocked.

strongest_changes: The nearby water, wind, and vessel sequences turn static usefulness into a maintained affordance network requiring human seeking and gratitude.
Repeated sign language across phenomena and recitation turns reflection into a world-text perceptual discipline that can also be resisted.
For-you language is bounded by self-accruing action, return, and recompense, making the subjected whole an accountable arena rather than human property.
The focus totalizer gains a future counterpart in gathering, communal summons, and a speaking record, so present use tends toward evidentiary assembly.
summary.what_was_special: The packet kept three normally suppressed activations live: service's coerced-labor shadow, split-root imagery of marks and apertures, and a mockery reversal in which imagined mastery collapses. The source phrase from Him and later dominion language prevented every one of these from becoming anthropocentric ownership.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact grammatical reach of the focus totalizer and source phrase affects whether source is predicated distributively of every item or of the gathered grant as a whole.
The marked-aperture model may be a productive material analogy from supplied split mappings or only lexicographic adjacency.
The later human gathering may deliberately reactivate the focus totality, or the shared root may coordinate otherwise distinct cosmic and eschatological scopes.
The context leaves open whether perceptual sealing is the accumulated mechanism of refusal, its imposed consequence, or both.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Collection requires mental circulation.** `ج م ع/B001` gathers scattered parts into a whole, while `ف ك ر/B001` turns a matter repeatedly in the mind. The packet first distributes signs across heaven, earth, organisms, weather, and sea (45:3-12), then gathers them here as `جميعاً`. I infer that reflection supplies the relational work of collecting these dispersed domains without erasing their differences. The ayah reads as a demand to construct a whole mechanism from many services, not merely to notice many separate gifts.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The later gatherings of people (45:26) and communities around their books (45:28) turn this cognitive gathering into an anticipatory analogue of judicial gathering.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **`جَمِيعًا` marks coordinated wholeness, not a maximal inventory.** Lexical anchors: wholeness without scattering in `ج م ع B009` and purposeful subjection in `س خ ر B001`. The packet supplies the sea-course as one subsystem in 45:12 and the joined gifts of book, judgment, prophethood, provision, and distinction in 45:16. I infer common source -> coordinated functions -> perceivable whole. "All, from Him" reads as integration across domains; the sign lies in their cooperation rather than simply in their number.
2. **Reflection turns relations over before they harden into divergent paths.** Lexical anchor: `ف ك ر B001` (turning a matter over in the mind) in `يَتَفَكَّرُونَ`. The packet supplies the unified source here, then disagreement after knowledge in 45:17 (`خ ل ف B004`) and the contrast between tracking the channel and tracking desires in 45:18. I infer mental turning -> testing how parts cohere -> guarded direction. Reflection is a relational operation that detects coordination and resists fragmentation, not free-floating speculation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 45:17-18 supplied the retrospective warning inside `يَتَفَكَّرُونَ`: a coordinated whole can be broken into divergent paths after knowledge, while reflection keeps testing the relation to its common source and visible channel.

baseline.text: Göklerde ve yerde ne varsa hepsini kendinden sizin hizmetinize verdi. Bunda düşünen bir topluluk için elbette işaretler vardır.

findings.text: Hepsinin hizmete verilmesi, varlıkların sayıca eksiksiz bir dökümünden çok, farklı alanların tek kaynaktan gelen amaçlı işlevlerle dağılmadan birlikte çalışmasıdır.
Düşünmek, gök, yer, canlılar, hava ve denizde dağılmış hizmetleri farklarını silmeden tek bir ilişkiler bütünü içinde toplamaktır.
Bu zihinsel toplama, daha sonraki insan ve topluluk toplanmalarının bilişsel bir ön örneğidir: dağılmış parçalar ortak ilişkileriyle bir bütüne çağrılır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Circulation Across Sky, Earth, and Sea (P1: 45:1-14)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Ordered motion transfers water, air, bodies, and living force from a source through a channel into a productive destination.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The signs are not static objects but a coordinated transport system in which descent, current, alternation, dispersal, and germination are different scales of one circulation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Harnessed Current Carries the Vessel
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Wind and water are directed into a navigable current that bears a vessel toward sought bounty.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: broad body of water (`quranic:root_000086:B001/m01`); flowing water, wind, and ship (`quranic:root_000240:B001/m01`); vessel moving on water (`quranic:root_001177:B003/m01`); wave moving back and forth (`quranic:root_001177:B007/m01`); wind and moving air (`quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`); directed shifting of winds and currents (`quranic:root_000860:B002/m01`); harnessing and facilitation (`quranic:root_000685:B001/m01`); purposeful seeking (`quranic:root_000138:B001/m01`); unowed bounty (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The sea is a field, the wind and current are instruments, the ship is the carried object, and bounty is the destination. Subjection therefore materializes as controlled transmission of force rather than inert possession.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Height, force, and magnitude establish rank, but self-assigned elevation is inverted into abasement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cosmic above-and-below relations become the scale by which human inflation is exposed and reversed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Height Is Stabilized by Power and Precision
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The elevated sky and lower ground form a vertical order governed by strength, accurate wisdom, and structural precision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: height and elevation (`quranic:root_000745:B001/m01`); overhead sky and canopy (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); the lower ground opposite the sky (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); strength and inviolable dignity (`quranic:root_001008:B001/m01`); wisdom that reaches the right judgment (`quranic:root_000348:B003/m01`); precise and secure construction (`quranic:root_000348:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Vertical space is presented as an ordered structure, not an empty backdrop. Power secures it and wisdom gives it right proportion, so cosmic height supplies the legitimate model of rank.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir şeyi bir buyruk ya da istenen sonuç doğrultusunda boyun eğdirme, yöneltme ve elverişli kılma çekirdeğinde birleşir. Bir kimse için kolaylaştırma ile geminin söz dinleyip rahat yol alması, bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir; bunlar alay etme ya da ücretsiz çalıştırma anlamını bu dala katmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, amaçlı boyun eğdirme ve elverişli kılmayla sınırlıdır; karşılıksız emek ve alay ayrı dallarda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, eylem adlarındaki genel çekirdeği korur; bir kimse için kolaylaştırma ve geminin söz dinlemesi gibi kuruluşlara bağlı kullanımları ayrıca sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bir buyruğa veya istenen işe boyun eğdirerek o işe yöneltmek ve elverişli kılmaktır. Bir kimse için kolaylaştırma ile geminin söz dinleyip rahat yol alması bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Bir şey, kimi zaman zor kullanılarak, belirli bir işe boyun eğdirilir ve istenen sonuca doğru yöneltilir.
Boyun eğdirme çekirdeği, bir şeyi bir kimsenin yararlanmasına elverişli ve kolay duruma getirmeyi de kapsar.
Gemiye bağlı kullanımda geminin söz dinlemesi, gidişinin rahatlaması ve rüzgarın ona uygun olması anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeyi buyruğa veya belirli bir işe boyun eğdirip yöneltme konusunda birleşir. Toplu anlatım ayrıca bir kimse için kolaylaştırmayı ve geminin uygun rüzgarla söz dinleyerek rahat ilerlemesini bu çekirdeğin bağlı görünümleri olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyi istenen işe boyun eğdirip yöneltme
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın bütün çekirdeği için kullanılır; amaçlı yöneltmeyi ve denetim altına almayı birlikte taşır.

error_profile.preserves: Boyun eğdirilen bir şeyi istenen işe yöneltme çekirdeğini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin bir kimsenin denetimine ve yararlanmasına hazır kılındığı bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Denetime verme ve yararlanmaya hazır kılma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Her durumda belirli bir işe doğru yöneltmeyi ve gemiye bağlı söz dinleme görünümünü açıkça taşımaz.

error_profile.loses: Boyun eğdirme, denetim altına alma ve belirli işe yöneltme çekirdeğini tek başına vermez.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir varlığı başkasının istediği işe koşma ve onun üzerinde denetim kurma yönü bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği amaçlı boyun eğdirme ve elverişli kılmadır; karşılık verilip verilmemesi belirleyici değildir. Komşu dalda ise zorla emek veya hizmet alma ve karşılıksızlık kurucu koşuldur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda bir şeyi buyruğa boyun eğdirip belirli işe yöneltme işlemi kurucudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda çalışmada, hizmette veya yürüyüşte çeviklik ve hız kurucudur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de söz dinleme, hizmete yönelme ve işi yürütme görünümünde kesişebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın gemiye bağlı kullanımında söz dinleme görülse de hız zorunlu değildir. Komşu dal ise çeviklik ve hızlı davranış üzerine kuruludur; bir şeyi buyruğa boyun eğdirme işlemini anlatmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; seçilen üç komşu boyun eğdirme, zorla hizmet ve söz dinleme sınırlarını keskinleştirir. Öteki adaylar yalnızca amaç, hız ya da sonuç alanını uzaktan paylaşır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التسخير والتذليل والتسهيل والإطاعة، كأن يسخر الله الشيء أو تطيع السفينة وتطيب لها الريح
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو الهزء بالناس، ولا خصوص العمل بلا أجرة إلا من جهة كونه صورة من التسخير
branches.source_phrase_ar: سخر الله الشيء إذا ذلله لأمره وإرادته (maqayis)؛ سخر الله لفلان أي سهله له (jamhara)؛ التسخير التذليل وسفن سواخر إذا أطاعت وطابت لها الريح (sihah)؛ سخرت السفينة إذا أطاعت وطاب لها السير وقد سخرها الله تسخيرا (tahdhib)؛ التسخير سياقة إلى الغرض المختص قهرا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir insanı zorlayarak karşılıksız çalıştırmayı ve bir hizmetçiyi ya da hayvanı karşılık vermeden kullanmayı açıkça dalın çekirdeği yapar. Köleler, kadın köleler ve ücretli çalışanlar üzerine yapılan açıklamalar katılımcı örnekleridir; genel kolaylaştırma veya alay anlamı değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın ayırıcı koşulları zorla emek ya da hizmet alma ile ücret, bedel veya başka bir karşılık vermemedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, eylem ve kişi adlarını zorla ve karşılıksız hizmet çekirdeğinde tutar; kişi ya da hayvanla kurulan kalıpları genel boyun eğdirme anlamına yaymaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı ya da hizmette kullanılan hayvanı, ücret veya başka bir karşılık vermeden zorla çalıştırmak veya kullanmaktır. Köle, hizmetçi ve ücretli çalışanlara ilişkin adlandırmalar bu çekirdekteki katılımcı türlerini gösterir.

facets.statement: Bir kimse baskıyla çalıştırılır ve yaptığı iş için ücret ya da başka bir karşılık almaz.
Bir hizmetçi veya binek hayvanı, ücret ya da bedel ödenmeden kullanılır.
Bazı açıklamalar zorla hizmete koşulan kişileri köleler, kadın köleler ve ücretli çalışanlar üzerinden örneklendirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, birini çalışmaya zorlayıp ücret vermeme konusunda birleşir. Toplu anlatım, karşılıksız kullanılan hizmetçi veya hayvanı ve baskıyla hizmete koşulan farklı kişi türlerini aynı çekirdeğe bağlı olarak kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan emeğini ve hizmette kullanılan hayvanı kapsayan dal çekirdeğinin en kısa doğal karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Zorlama, çalışma veya hizmet alma ve karşılık vermeme koşullarının tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın ücret ödenmeden baskıyla çalıştırıldığı düz anlatım bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan katılımcı, zorlama, çalışma ve ücret ödememe koşullarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimseye istemediği ve karşılıksız bir iş yaptırma bağlamında doğal, ancak daha geniş çağrışımlı bir anlatımdır.

error_profile.preserves: İstem dışı ağır işe koşma yönünü ve baskı görünümünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Güncel kullanımda yalnızca külfetli veya istenmeyen, fakat mutlaka ücretsiz olmayan işleri de çağrıştırabilir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir hizmetçiyi ya da binek hayvanını karşılık vermeden kullanmak

error_profile.preserves: Baskı altında başkasına hizmet etme alanıyla bağlantıyı korur.
error_profile.loses: Belirli bir çalıştırma eylemini ve karşılık vermeme koşulunu doğrudan anlatmaz.
error_profile.adds: Bir kişinin hukuki veya toplumsal konumunu ve sahiplik ilişkisini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Eylemi, kalıcı kişi konumu ve sahiplik düzeniyle karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bir insanı ya da hizmette kullanılan hayvanı karşılık vermeden zorla çalıştırmayı gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, her tür şeyi belirli işe boyun eğdirip yöneltmeyi, kolaylaştırmayı ve geminin söz dinlemesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: karşılıksız zorla çalıştırma ile amaçlı boyun eğdirme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir varlığın başkasının istediği işe koşulması ve denetim altına alınması bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta zorlama ile karşılıksız emek veya kullanım birlikte kurucudur. Komşuda ise ücret koşulu yoktur; kolaylaştırma ve cansız şeylerin işe elverişli kılınması da kapsama girer.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda hizmet zorla alınır ve ücret ya da başka bir karşılık verilmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, hizmeti ve birinin hizmetçi olarak çalışmasını zorlama veya karşılıksızlık şartı olmadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: zorla karşılıksız hizmet ile genel hizmet
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal insanın başkası için çalışması, hizmet etmesi ve kullanılması alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak, hizmet ilişkisinin nasıl kurulduğunu belirleyen iki koşul taşır: baskı ve karşılıksızlık. Komşu hizmeti genel olarak adlandırdığı için gönüllü veya ücretli çalışma da onun alanında kalabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal birini zorla ve karşılıksız çalıştırma eylemini anlatır; sahiplik konumu gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özgür olmayan, alınıp satılabilen kişinin sahiplik ve kölelik konumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Baskı altında hizmet, özgürlük yoksunluğu ve başkasının denetiminde çalışma aynı toplumsal alanda görülebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bir kişi kölelik konumunda olmadan da karşılıksız zorla çalıştırılabilir; tersine kölelik sözü belirli bir çalıştırma olayını bildirmez. Bu nedenle çekirdekler değil, yalnızca alan ortaktır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen komşular genel boyun eğdirme, genel hizmet ve kölelik konumuyla olan başlıca karışmaları ayırır. Ötekiler yalnızca işçi türü, baskı veya kullanma alanını uzaktan paylaşır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السخرة والعمل المسخر بلا أجرة، وتسخر الخادم أو الدابة، وما حملته بعض المصادر على العبيد والإماء والأجراء
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مطلق تيسير الأشياء وتسخيرها للغرض، ولا الهزء والسخرية
branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل سخره يسخر في العمل (maqayis)؛ كلفته عملا بلا أجرة وهي السخرة (jamhara)؛ سخره تسخيرا كلفه عملا بلا أجرة وكذلك تسخره (sihah)؛ ما تسخرت من خادم أو دابة بلا أجر ولا ثمن وعبيدا وإماء وأجراء وتسخرت دابة ركبتها بغير أجر (tahdhib)؛ السخري هو الذي يقهر فيتسخر بإرادته (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü dalı açıkça birini alaya alma üzerinde kurar ve aynı söz ailesiyle alay eylemini, alay eden kişiyi ve alaya alınan kişiyi adlandırır. Gülme yalnızca tekil bir ad kullanımında görülür; bu yüzden dal başlığındaki gülme, çekirdeğin zorunlu parçası değil alaylı bir gerçekleşme olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, birini alaya almaktır; gerçek bir gülme olayı zorunlu değildir ve yalnızca bağlı bir kullanımda yer alır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, ilgeçli eylem kuruluşlarını ve eylem ya da kişi bildiren türemiş biçimleri ayırır; bunları yalın kökün sınırsız anlamı gibi sunmaz.

concept_map.definition: Birini küçümseyici biçimde alaya almak ve onun üzerinden eğlenmektir. Bağlı adlandırmalar alay eylemini, alay eden veya alaya alınan kişiyi ve tekil bir kullanımda alaylı gülüşü belirtir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi küçümseyici söz veya davranışla alaya alınır.
Eylemin kaynak dilde iki ayrı ilgeçli kuruluşu kaydedilir ve bunlardan birinin kabulü konusunda görüş ayrılığı vardır.
Aynı söz ailesi alay eylemini, alay eden kişiyi veya başkalarının alay ettiği kişiyi adlandırabilir.
Tekil bir kullanım, alaylı gülüşü ya da alay amacıyla gülme eylemini adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar birini alaya alma çekirdeğinde birleşir ve eylem adı ile alay eden ya da alaya alınan kişiye ilişkin adları kaydeder. Toplu anlatım, eylemin iki ilgeçli kuruluşundan biri üzerindeki görüş ayrılığını ve tekil alaylı gülüş kullanımını da korur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın kişi, kuruluş ve türemiş adlardan önce gelen ortak eylem çekirdeğini doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişiyi küçümseyici tutumla alay konusu yapma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin söz veya davranışla küçümsenip eğlence konusu yapıldığı genel cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Alay eden ile alaya alınan kişi arasındaki eylemi ve küçümseyici yönü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gündelik ve konuşma diline yakın bağlamlarda birini alay konusu yapmayı anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişiyi alay konusu yapma ve onun üzerinden eğlenme yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Dostça takılma veya sert küçümseme içermeyen şakalaşma çağrışımını da taşıyabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Alay sırasında görülebilecek gülme davranışını korur.
error_profile.adds: Sevinç, şaşkınlık veya eğlence gibi alay içermeyen bütün gülme nedenlerini kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Alay eylemini onun zorunlu olmayan bir dış görünümüyle karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, ilgeçli kuruluşları ve alay eden ya da alaya alınan kişiyi bildiren türemiş adları kendi söz ailesi içinde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, gizli veya ince şakalaşmaya yaklaşan bir eğlenme görünümünü de açıkça alanına alır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: alay etmek ile ince şakaya uzanan alay
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak çekirdeği bir kişiyi alaya almak, onunla eğlenmek ve küçümseyici bir tutum göstermektir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Temel alay bağlamlarında iki dal büyük ölçüde örtüşür. Komşunun ince şakaya uzanan kapsamı ve odağın kendi kişi adları ile kuruluşları, tam sınır eşitliğini engeller.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal alay etme eylemini ve alay eden ya da alaya alınan kişiyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, gülmeye yol açan şeyi veya kendisine gülünen nesneyi merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: alay etme ile gülünç bulunan şey
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişi ya da şeyin başkalarının alaylı gülmesine konu olması iki dalın kesiştiği bölgedir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta kurucu unsur birinin yaptığı alay eylemidir; gerçek gülme zorunlu değildir. Komşuda ise gülünç bulunan veya kendisine gülünen şey öne çıkar, alay edenin eylemi çekirdek değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, birini eğlence konusu yaparak alaya alma biçimini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, kusur bulma, azarlama, değersiz görme ve değerini düşürme yollarını alay bulunmadan da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: alaya alma ile kusur bulup küçültme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişiye küçümseyici yaklaşabilir ve onun toplum içindeki değerini düşürebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Alay, küçümsemenin eğlenme ve gülünçleştirme yoluyla yapılan özel biçimidir. Komşu dalın kusur bulma, kınama ve değerini düşürme çekirdeği ise eğlenme ya da alay gerektirmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen üç komşu alayın eş anlamlı alanını, gülünç bulunan nesneyi ve genel küçümsemeyi ayırır. Öteki adaylar hakaret, kötü söz, sitem veya aynı kökün uzak dalları düzeyinde kalır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه سخرت منه أو به، والسخرية والسخري بمعنى الهزء، ووصف من يسخر من الناس أو يسخر الناس منه
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس تسخير الشيء وتذليله، ولا السخرة بمعنى العمل بلا أجرة
branches.source_phrase_ar: سخرت منه إذا هزئت به (maqayis)؛ سخرت من الرجل سخرية وسخرا وسخريا ورجل سخرة يسخر من الناس وسخرة يسخر الناس منه (jamhara)؛ سخرت منه وسخرت به وهزئت منه وهزئت به والاسم السخرية والسخرى والسخري (sihah)؛ سخر منه وبه إذا تهزأ به والسخرية مصدر (tahdhib)؛ سخرت منه واستسخرته للهزء منه والسخرية لفعل الساخر (mufradat)

root_profile.summary: Kök, bir şeyi istenen işe boyun eğdirip elverişli kılma çekirdeğinden karşılıksız zorla çalıştırmaya uzanan iki bağlantılı dal ile birini alaya alma dalını taşır. Alay dalı, ilk iki daldaki denetim ve hizmet alanından ayrı bir anlam kümesi oluşturur.

lu_002.text: bir şeyi buyruğa boyun eğdirip biri için kolaylaştırmak

lu_004.text: geminin söz dinleyip uygun rüzgarla rahat yol alması

lu_007.text: bir hizmetçiyi ya da binek hayvanını karşılık vermeden kullanmak

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi dalın çekirdeğini hem somut yükselme hem de kişinin değerinin ve anılma düzeyinin yükselmesi olarak açıkça kurar. Bakışın yukarı yönelmesi bu çekirdeğin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel yükselmeyi kapsar; gök, ad, av ve yarışma dallarının kalıplaşmış anlamlarını kendi içine almaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel yükselme çekirdeği ile bakış, toplumsal konum ve gururlu duruşa bağlı özel kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin fiziksel olarak yukarı çıkması veya bir kişinin toplumsal değerinin ve anılma düzeyinin yükselmesidir. Bakışın yukarı kaldırılması bu hareketin özel bir uygulamasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey bulunduğu düzeyden yukarı çıkar veya yüksek duruma gelir.
Bir kişinin değeri, saygınlığı ya da toplumdaki yeri yükselir.
Bakış bir şeye doğru yukarı kaldırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yükselmeyi dalın ortak çekirdeği sayar; bunu fiziksel yükselişe, bakışın kaldırılmasına ve değerli kişinin toplumdaki yerinin yükselmesine uygular.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın somut yükselme çekirdeğini ve kişinin değer ya da saygınlık bakımından yükselmesini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yukarı çıkma ile toplumsal değer artışını aynı yükselme ekseninde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin fiziksel olarak daha yüksek bir düzeye çıkmasını anlatan genel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Fiziksel yukarı çıkma hareketini doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin toplumdaki değerinin veya konumunun yükseldiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin toplumsal değer bakımından yükselmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bakışın daha yüksekteki bir şeye yöneltildiği özel bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bakışın yukarı doğru kaldırılması işlemini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: toplumdaki yeri ve değeri yükselmiş olmak

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir şeyin yükselmesi ve yüksek duruma gelmesi yönündeki aynı genel çekirdeği anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kanıtta çekirdek kapsamı ayıran bir koşul görünmez; bakış, toplumsal değer ve dağın en yüksek yeriyle ilgili bağımlı kullanımlar bu genel yükselme eşdeğerliğini bozmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalı kişinin değer kazanmasını ve bakışın yukarı yönelmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyi kaldırma eylemini ve uzunluk gibi ek yüksek görünüşleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yükseklik kazanma ve yukarı yönelme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında temel işlem öznenin yükselmesidir; komşuda bunun yanında bir nesneyi yükseltme ve başka yüksek görünüşler de çekirdeğe girer.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda yükselme, uzaktan görünür hale gelme koşulu olmadan da gerçekleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda yüksek bir görünüşün uzaktan belirmesi ve seçilmesi zorunludur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da yükseklik kazanmış bir şey bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı genel yükselme sürecini anlatır; komşu dal ise yükselen şeyin uzaktan görünür ve seçilebilir bir görünüş oluşturmasını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; yalnız dalın genel yükselme sınırını en açık biçimde gösteren üç karşılaştırma yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه سمو الشيء وعلوه، وارتفاع البصر، وعلو الحسيب والشريف، ورفعة الذكر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه استعمال السماء للسقف أو المطر، ولا باب الاسم إلا من جهة اشتقاقه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل يدل على العلو؛ سموت إذا علوت (maqayis)؛ سما الشيء يسمو سموا أي ارتفع (ayn)؛ السمو الارتفاع والعلو (sihah)؛ سما الشيء يسمو سموا وهو ارتفاعه، ويقال للحسيب والشريف قد سما (tahdhib)؛ أصله من السمو وهو الذي به رفع ذكر المسمى (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi yalnız yükselmeyi değil, yükselen şeyin uzaktan belirip seçilebilir hale gelmesini de şart koşar. Ayın ince yayının ufuk üstündeki görünüşü bu çekirdeğin belirtilmiş örneğidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, görünür bir yüksek gövde ya da çizgi gerektirir; görünmeden gerçekleşen genel yükselme bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Uzaktan belirme çekirdeği, belirli görünme kalıpları ve ayın ufuk üstündeki görünüşüyle birlikte fakat ayrı kapsamlarla verilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üzerinde bulunan ve onu örten gök, tavan ya da genel üst yandır. Bu ad buluta, yukarıdan gelen yağmura, yağmurla çıkan veya yükselen bitkiye ve atın sırtına da aktarılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi çekirdeği bir topluluğun ıssız arazilere av için çıkması olarak verir; avcı adı, av hayvanını arama ve avcının sıcak zeminde beklerken giydiği çorap da aynı av alanına bağlıdır. Dal çerçevesi bu bağı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel gitmeyi değil, av amacıyla açık ve ıssız araziye çıkmayı ve yalnız buna bağlı kişi, arama ve araç kullanımlarını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Av için araziye çıkma çekirdeği; avcı, av hayvanını arama ve avcı çorabı bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun avlanmak için kır ve çöl gibi ıssız arazilere çıkmasıdır. Avcılar, av hayvanını arama ve avcının sıcak zeminde beklerken giydiği koruyucu çorap bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir topluluk avlanmak amacıyla kır veya çöl gibi ıssız araziye çıkar.
Bu amaçla araziye çıkan kişiler avcı adıyla anılır.
Av hayvanını bulup avlamak üzere arama eylemi aynı alana bağlıdır.
Avcının sıcak zeminde hayvan beklerken ayağını korumak için giydiği çorap adlandırılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve birbirine karşı koymayı aynı dalda birleştirir; kimsenin yarışamadığı kişi ifadesi de bu karşılaştırma eksenine dayanır. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu yapıyı doğru karşılar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal karşılıklı yarışma ve denk gelme alanındadır; yalnız aynı adı taşıma ya da genel üstünlük bu karşılıklılık olmadan dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karşılıklı yarışma çekirdeği, övünerek boy ölçüşme, karşı koyma ve kimsenin yarışamaması bildiren özel biçimlerle karıştırılmadan verilir.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın üstün gelmek için birbiriyle yarışması, övünerek boy ölçüşmesi veya birbirine karşı koymasıdır. Bir kimseyle hiç kimsenin yarışamaması, onun bu karşılaştırmada erişilemez üstünlüğünü bildirir.

facets.statement: İki veya daha çok taraf üstün gelmek için karşılıklı olarak yarışır.
Taraflar sahip oldukları üstünlüklerle övünerek birbirleriyle boy ölçüşür.
Taraflardan biri ötekine karşı koyar, onunla aynı düzeye gelmeye veya onu geçmeye çalışır.
Kimsenin bir kişiyle yarışamaması, o kişinin erişilemez ölçüde üstün olduğunu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve karşı koyma anlamlarını birleştirir; bir kişiyle kimsenin yarışamaması ifadesini onun üstünlüğünün sonucu olarak verir.

facets.statement: Bir nesne veya hayvan üzerinde onu tanıtmaya ve başkalarından ayırmaya yarayan görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturulur.

Eylemin sonucunda kalan tanıtıcı iz de aynı anlam alanında adlandırılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişide görülen belirtiyi okuyarak iyilik, kötülük veya genel durum hakkında sonuç çıkarma eylemini açıkça anlatır. Dal çerçevesindeki bakma, belirti ve çıkarım ilişkisi bu anlamı doğru korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kişideki belirtiyi yorumlama çekirdeğini verir; iyilik veya kötülükle kurulan özel yapılar bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişide görülen belirti veya izlere dikkatle bakarak onun iyiliği, kötülüğü, niteliği ya da durumu hakkında sezgisel bir sonuca varmaktır. Anlam, belirtinin kendisinden çok onu okuyup görünmeyen bir niteliği çıkarma eylemine dayanır.

facets.statement: Kişide görülen bir belirti, görünmeyen bir nitelik veya durumun göstergesi olarak okunur.
Gözlemden hareketle sezgisel bir değerlendirme ve çıkarım yapılır.
Çıkarılan nitelik iyilik de kötülük de olabilir; anlam yalnızca olumlu bir yargıyla sınırlı değildir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, kişideki görünür bir izin onun iyiliğine, kötülüğüne veya durumuna işaret ettiğini fark etmek ve bu işaretten sezgisel bir sonuç çıkarmaktır. Bakan kişi, belirtiyi anlam taşıyan bir gösterge olarak değerlendirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yılın veya ilkbahar döneminin ilk yağmurunu ve bu yağmurun toprağı bitkiyle görünür biçimde değiştirmesini birlikte temel alır. Sağlanan dal imgesi hem zaman koşulunu hem de bitkisel sonucu doğru yansıtır.

concept_map.definition: Yılın başlangıcında veya ilkbaharın ilk döneminde yağan ve toprağı bitkilendirerek üzerinde görünür bir etki bırakan ilk yağmurdur. Bu yağmuru alıp etkisini taşıyan toprak da dala bağlı bir sonuç durumudur.

facets.statement: Yağmur, yılın ya da ilkbaharın ilk döneminde görülen ilk yağış olarak zaman bakımından sınırlandırılır.
